preconditions.description: The number of rows n must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of columns m must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'DIMAD' for row in table for c in row)
preconditions.description: Each character in the table must be one of 'D', 'I', 'M', 'A'.

postconditions.description: If Inna cannot go through the name DIMA once, output 'Poor Dima!'.
If Inna can go through the name DIMA an infinite number of times, output 'Poor Inna!'.
If Inna can go through the name DIMA a finite number of times, output the maximum number of times as a positive integer.
